summary: Build a public personal journaling/story site where only the owner can create daily posts (text + photo/video), with some posts free and others paywalled; users must log in with Internet Identity to view locked posts, with a view toward future monetization and added health-progress tracking.
architectural_notes: Single-author system: only the site owner can create/manage posts; public users are readers only.
Access control model: posts have free vs locked visibility; locked content requires Internet Identity login to view.
Post timestamps/dates should be stored and rendered using Australia/Sydney timezone defaults (at least for initial MVP).
Existing posts may have incorrect stored timestamps (not just 1970); add/maintain a migration pathway to normalize legacy `createdAt` values to correct Australia/Sydney dates.

Provide an idempotent, repeatable admin/migration pathway to correct specific legacy posts' `createdAt` values (e.g., force-set "Backroads Litter" to the current date) while persisting the updated timestamp in canister state.
known_issues: Bug: Editing existing posts in admin does not persist changes (title and content changes do not save); Save closes editor as if successful but post remains unchanged.
Bug: Posts display date as 1970; need to default to today's date in Australia/Sydney for new posts and correct existing posts already showing 1970.
Bug: Existing post date is still incorrect for the only post currently on the site ('Backroads Litter') — it displays as 23 November 2022 while today's date is 08 January 2026 (Australia/Sydney).
Root cause hypothesis: backend is storing `createdAt = 0` on post creation, leading to incorrect rendered dates (e.g., “Backroads Litter” not showing today’s Australia/Sydney date).

existing_features.title: Add an owner-only authoring/admin workflow so only the site owner can create and manage posts.
Gate locked posts behind Internet Identity login: users can browse free content publicly, but must sign in with Internet Identity to view locked post content.

Implement a minimal paywall entitlement mechanism for locked posts (without integrating payments): after Internet Identity login, only principals that are explicitly allowed can view locked content; the owner can grant/revoke access.
Support media attachments on posts in the initial version: allow adding images and videos to a post, and display them in post detail views.
Create public-facing pages for browsing and reading posts: a home/feed page, a post detail page, and basic navigation.
Add a coherent visual theme and typography system for the journal app and apply it consistently across pages.
Add basic content safety/quality constraints and empty/loading states throughout the UI.

Update frontend date formatting to display post dates in the Australia/Sydney timezone consistently anywhere a post date is shown (home feed, post detail, and admin post list), using English locale formatting.

Ensure the frontend shows the corrected date for the "Backroads Litter" post on both the home feed and the post detail page after the backend `createdAt` migration is applied (no UI regressions to existing date formatting behavior).
Expose the backend force-set-date operation in the Admin UI so the owner can re-run the fix for a chosen post (e.g., the existing “Backroads Litter” post) and immediately see the updated date.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create daily public posts (single author) with text content and basic post listing/detail views
Support media attachments on posts (photo and video upload/embedding) in the initial version
Paywall individual posts: mark posts as free vs locked and restrict locked content
Internet Identity authentication required only to view paywalled (locked) posts
Owner-only authoring/admin workflow so only the site owner can create and manage posts
Implement backend data model and APIs for a single-author journal with posts that can be marked as free or locked, including create/update/delete and public read access.

Fix the backend post data model so that post titles are persisted and returned by the public read APIs (getPost and getAllPosts), and ensure updates to an existing post persist both title and content.

Add a safe upgrade path for existing canister state so that previously stored posts (which were missing title storage) can be upgraded without trapping, with reasonable default titles for existing posts.
Fix post date handling: default new posts to current date in Australia/Sydney timezone and migrate existing posts showing 1970 to a reasonable current/valid date
Fix backend post creation timestamps so that newly created posts store a real current timestamp (seconds since Unix epoch) instead of deriving `createdAt` from `postId`.

Add a safe upgrade/migration step that updates existing stored posts whose `createdAt` values are invalid (e.g., values that render as 1970) to a reasonable current timestamp, so older posts no longer display as 1970 after upgrade.

Update canister upgrade/migration logic so the existing post titled "Backroads Litter" has its stored `createdAt` corrected to a timestamp that displays as 08 January 2026 in the Australia/Sydney timezone (based on the current date the user provided). This change must update the persisted state so the fix is permanent (not just a frontend formatting change).
Update backend post creation so `createdAt` is stored as the current Unix epoch timestamp in seconds (Nat64) instead of `0` when the owner creates a new post.

Add a safe canister upgrade migration that permanently corrects invalid `createdAt` values in persisted posts, including ensuring the existing post titled "Backroads Litter" has a stored `createdAt` that renders as "08 January 2026" in the Australia/Sydney timezone.

Re-run the backend migration/correction to force-set the existing "Backroads Litter" post's stored `createdAt` to today’s exact date (current Australia/Sydney date), persisting the change so it remains correct after refresh/upgrade.
Add an owner/admin-only backend operation that force-updates an existing post’s stored `createdAt` timestamp to the current time (today’s exact date), persisted in canister state.

projectName: Public journal/story site with single-author posting, media attachments, and II-gated locked posts
